docs.title: wapi
docs.text:
A complete, typed Python client for the WhatsApp Business Platform — Cloud API, Business Management API, Flows API, Calling API, and webhooks.

from wapi import Client
from wapi.builders import Buttons, Template

client = Client(
    access_token="EAAB...",
    phone_number_id="106540352242922",
    waba_id="102290129340398",
)

client.messages.send_text(to="15551234567", body="Hello!")
client.messages.send_interactive(
    to="15551234567",
    interactive=Buttons().body("Pick one").add("Yes", "y").add("No", "n"),
)
client.messages.send_template(
    to="15551234567",
    template=Template("order_conf", "en_US").body_params("Ana", "1234"),
)

docs.title: Why wapi
docs.text:
• Complete — every endpoint on the platform: ~100 operations across messaging, media, templates, phone numbers, calling, groups, flows, marketing messages, and account admin.
  • Ergonomic — client.messages.send_text(to, body) and fluent builders instead of hand-written JSON dicts.
  • Typed — Pydantic models for every response and webhook event; mypy --strict clean.
  • Sync + Async — Client and AsyncClient with the same API surface.
  • Webhooks — signature verification, typed event parsing, and a ready FastAPI router.

docs.title: WhatsApp Business Platform — Complete API Reference
docs.text:
Catalog of every endpoint, method, and option exposed by the WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API + Business Management API + Flows API), verified against Meta's official API reference (November 2026, Graph API v21+).

This document is the build spec for the wapi package: every resource class in the plan maps to a section here.

docs.title: 1. Fundamentals
docs.text: Item Value Base URL https://graph.facebook.com/{VERSION} Current versions v21.0 – v25.0 (version is part of the path, configurable in the client) Auth Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN> (system-user or user token) Content types application/json (most calls), multipart/form-data (media/asset uploads) Pagination Cursor-based: limit, after, before; response paging.cursors / paging.next Field selection ?fields=a,b,c on almost every GET

docs.title: Required permissions
docs.text: Scope Needed for whatsapp_business_messaging Sending messages, media upload/download, calls, groups, marketing messages whatsapp_business_management Templates, phone numbers, registration, profiles, QR codes, flows, webhooks, WABA admin business_management Business portfolio / partner-level endpoints catalog_management Product/catalog messages (plus commerce settings)

docs.title: 2. Messages — whatsapp-business-phone-number
docs.text: The central endpoint. One POST handles every outbound message type, plus read receipts and typing indicators.

docs.title: POST /{Phone-Number-ID}/messages
docs.text:
Base fields (all message types):

Field Type Required Notes messaging_product "whatsapp" ✓ Always recipient_type "individual" | "group" ✓ group for group chats to string ✓ E.164 phone number, WhatsApp user ID, or group ID type string ✓ See message types below context object { "message_id": "<wamid>" } — quote/reply biz_opaque_callback_data string ≤512 chars, echoed back in status webhooks status "read" For read receipts (see below)

docs.title: Message types (type field)
docs.text: type Payload key Options text text body (≤4096), preview_url (bool) for link previews image image id or link, caption audio audio id or link video video id or link, caption document document id or link, caption, filename sticker sticker id or link (WebP 512×512, ≤100KB static / 500KB animated) location location latitude, longitude, name, address contacts contacts Array of contact objects: name (formatted_name, first_name…), phones (phone, wa_id, type), emails, urls, addresses, birthday, org reaction reaction message_id, emoji (empty string removes reaction) template template name, language.code, components[] (see §4) interactive interactive type, header, body, footer, action (see below) address address (interactive, India) Address-form interactive message location_request via interactive.action.name: "send_location" Requests user's location

docs.title: Interactive message action options
docs.text:
interactive.type action fields button (reply buttons) buttons[] — max 3, each {type:"reply", reply:{id,title(≤20)}} list button (label), sections[] — max 10, rows per section max 10, each row {id,title(≤24),description} cta_url name:"cta_url", parameters:{display_text,url} catalog_message name:"catalog_message", parameters:{thumbnail_product_retailer_id?} product (SPM) catalog_id, product_retailer_id product_list (MPM) catalog_id, sections[] with product_items[] (product_retailer_id), max 30 items flow name:"flow", parameters:{flow_token?, flow_id or flow_name, flow_cta, flow_action:"navigate"|"data_exchange", flow_action_payload:{screen, data}},mode:"draft"` for draft flows call_permission_request Call permission request interactive order_details India payments order message order_status Order status update wa_pay / payment_settings Brazil/ROW payments voice_call Voice call CTA button location_request_message name:"send_location" body

Headers for interactive: type: text|image|video|document + matching payload; sub_text optional. body.text, footer.text optional/required by type.

docs.title: Read receipts & typing indicator
docs.text:
Same endpoint, sentinel payload:

{ "messaging_product":"whatsapp", "status":"read",
  "message_id":"<wamid>",
  "typing_indicator": { "type":"text" } }

typing_indicator is optional; include to show "typing…" in the user's app.

docs.title: 4. Message Templates — whatsapp-business-account
docs.text:
Method Path Purpose GET /{WABA-ID}/message_templates List templates. Query: fields, limit, after, before; filters via fields (name, category, status, language, quality_score, components, id, rejected_reason) POST /{WABA-ID}/message_templates Create template GET /{TEMPLATE_ID} Get one template (fields) POST /{TEMPLATE_ID} Edit template DELETE /{WABA-ID}/message_templates Delete by name (all languages), name+hsm_id (one language), or hsm_ids JSON array (≤100) POST /{WABA-ID}/migrate_message_templates Migrate templates between WABAs (source/destination WABA + template names)

Create/edit body: name* (lowercase, _), language* (e.g. en_US), category* (UTILITY|MARKETING|AUTHENTICATION), components[], parameter_format (named|positional), allow_category_change, cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out, message_send_ttl_seconds, sub_category, display_format, library_template_name + library_template_body_inputs/library_template_button_inputs (clone from library), is_primary_device_delivery_only, send_type (MM Lite).

Components: HEADER (format: TEXT|IMAGE|VIDEO|DOCUMENT|LOCATION|PRODUCT, example.header_text / example.header_handle), BODY (text with {{1}}/{{name}} params, example.body_text/body_text_named_params), FOOTER, BUTTONS (QUICK_REPLY, URL, PHONE_NUMBER, OTP, COPY_CODE, CATALOG, MPM, SPM, FLOW, VOICE_CALL, APP), CAROUSEL (media card carousels), LIMITED_TIME_OFFER.

Statuses: APPROVED, PENDING/IN_APPEAL, REJECTED, PAUSED, DISABLED, PENDING_DELETION, DELETED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED. Quality scores GREEN/YELLOW/RED/UNKNOWN via quality_score field.

Rate limit: max 100 template creates per WABA per hour.

docs.text:
Method Path Purpose Body/params GET /{Phone-Number-ID}/call_permissions Check permission to call a user user_wa_id* → permission.status (granted/pending/denied/expired), actions[] (start_call, send_call_permission_request + rate limits) POST /{Phone-Number-ID}/calls Manage calls messaging_product, action*

docs.title: messages value payloads
docs.text:
• Inbound messages[] types: text, image, audio, video, document, sticker, location, contacts, reaction, interactive (button_reply, list_reply, nfm_reply for Flows, product_inquiry, order, address), button, order, system, referral, unknown/unsupported, group_*, call_*.
  • statuses[]: sent, delivered, read, failed (with errors[] code + error_data.details), warning; includes conversation{id, origin.type} and pricing{pricing_model, category, billable}.
  • contacts[] (sender wa_id, profile.name), metadata (display_phone_number, phone_number_id), errors[], identity (user identity change hash).
  • echoes (SMB/coexistence), history (chat sync), smb_app_state_sync.

docs.title: 13. Supporting APIs & mechanics
docs.text:
• OAuth / Embedded Signup: GET /oauth/access_token (code → user token); GET /{App-ID}/subscriptions to manage webhook field subscriptions.
  • Coexistence (Business app + API): POST /{Phone-Number-ID}/smb_app_data (chat history sync payload from embedded signup).
  • User identity change: check settings → user_identity_change; webhook identity field carries the identity hash; verify before trusting profile data.
  • Error model: {error:{message,type,code,error_subcode,fbtrace_id, error_data{details},error_user_title,error_user_msg}}. Common families: 131xxx (send/template errors), 132xxx (params), 133xxx (registration/phone), 4xx OAuth, rate limits (#4/80007/131056 pair-rate).
  • Throughput: ~80 msg/s per phone number (1,000/s high-throughput tier); template pacing + per-user marketing template limits apply.
  • 24-hour customer service window: free-form messages only inside the window opened by the last inbound user message; outside → template required.

docs.title: Retries
docs.text:

client.retry.base_delay = 1.0           # tune via RetryPolicy

docs.title: wapi — WhatsApp Business Platform Python Client: Build Plan
docs.text: A complete, well-organized, easy-to-use Python package covering the entire WhatsApp Business Platform. docs/api-reference.md is the endpoint spec; this document is the architecture and delivery plan.

docs.title: 1. Design goals
docs.text:
1. Complete — every endpoint in api-reference.md (~100 operations), including calls, groups, flows, marketing messages, and WABA/partner admin.
  2. Ergonomic — client.messages.send_text(to, body) not raw dicts; fluent builders for interactive/template payloads.
  3. Typed — Pydantic v2 models for every request body, response, and webhook event. Full mypy --strict coverage.
  4. Sync + Async — one codebase, Client and AsyncClient sharing resource classes over httpx.
  5. Framework-agnostic webhooks — signature verification + typed event parsing that plugs into Flask/FastAPI/Django or plain functions.
  6. Zero-surprise defaults — sane retries on rate limits, cursor pagination iterators, clear exception hierarchy mapped to Meta error codes.

docs.title: 2. Tech choices
docs.text:
Concern Choice Why HTTP httpx Sync+async, HTTP/2, multipart, streaming downloads Models pydantic v2 Validation, model_dump(exclude_none=True), JSON Schema for docs Packaging pyproject.toml + hatchling Modern, simple Lint/format ruff Fast, one tool Types mypy --strict Public API fully typed Tests pytest + respx respx mocks httpx transport — no network needed Docs mkdocs-material + mkdocstrings Auto API docs from docstrings CI GitHub Actions lint, typecheck, test matrix (3.10–3.13), build Versioning SemVer; API_VERSION default "v25.0" pinned, user-overridable

No framework dependencies. Optional extras: wapi[fastapi] (webhook router), wapi[flask] later if wanted.

WhatsAppError

docs.title: 7. Testing strategy
docs.text:
• Unit: respx-mocked Graph API; assert URL, method, JSON body per method.
  • Payload fixtures: real request/response samples from Meta docs under tests/fixtures/ (messages, webhooks, template create, error envelopes).
  • Webhook: canned webhook JSON per type; HMAC sign/verify round-trip.
  • Types: mypy --strict in CI; pyright optional check.
  • Coverage: ≥90% on resources/ + webhooks/; builders 100%.
  • Live (manual): tests/live/ gated behind env vars (WA_TOKEN, WA_PHONE_NUMBER_ID, WA_TEST_RECIPIENT) — never runs in CI.

docs.title: 8. Decisions
docs.text:
• Name: wapi (verify PyPI availability at publish time; fallback wabapi).
  • v1 scope — core first: messages (+ marketing), media, templates, phone numbers, profile/QR/block/commerce/automation/encryption, calling, groups, flows, webhooks. Partner/admin tier (business portfolio, app solutions, pre-verified numbers, assigned users, credits, migration) ships in v1.1 — the resources/ layout already reserves business.py, app.py, users.py for it.
  • Webhooks: signature verification + typed parser plus an optional FastAPI router under wapi[fastapi] that auto-verifies and dispatches.
  • Python: 3.10+.
  • Excluded: On-Premises API (deprecated by Meta), Embedded Signup frontend JS (documented, not implemented), Payments order APIs beyond sending the documented message payloads.

class Interactive(Payload):
    """Base for ``type: interactive`` payloads."""

    def __init__(self, type: str) -> None:
        self.type = type
        self._header: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        self._body: str | None = None
        self._footer: str | None = None
        self._action: dict[str, Any] = {}

    def header_text(self, text: str, *, sub_text: str | None = None) -> Interactive:
        self._header = clean_body({"type": "text", "text": text, "sub_text": sub_text})
        return self

    def header_media(
        self, kind: str, *, media_id: str | None = None, link: str | None = None
    ) -> Interactive:
        if kind not in ("image", "video", "document"):
            raise ValueError("header media kind must be image, video, or document")
        self._header = {"type": kind, kind: Media(media_id=media_id, link=link).to_dict()}
        return self

    def body(self, text: str) -> Interactive:
        self._body = text
        return self

    def footer(self, text: str) -> Interactive:
        self._footer = text
        return self

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return clean_body(
            {
                "type": self.type,
                "header": self._header,
                "body": {"text": self._body} if self._body else None,
                "footer": {"text": self._footer} if self._footer else None,
                "action": self._action or None,

        self._draft = draft

        self._screen = screen

            "type": "currency",
            "currency": {
                "fallback_value": f"{code} {amount_1000 / 1000:.2f}",
                "code": code,
                "amount_1000": int(amount_1000),
            },
        }

    @staticmethod
    def date_time(fallback: str, *, timestamp: int | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
        dt: dict[str, Any] = {"fallback_value": fallback}

    @staticmethod
    def image(*, media_id: str | None = None, link: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:

    @staticmethod

def clean_body(body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recursively drop ``None`` values from a JSON body."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in body.items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            out[key] = clean_body(value)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            out[key] = [clean_body(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v for v in value]
        else:
            out[key] = value
    return out

        url = build_url(self.base_url, self.api_version, spec)

            self._http, url=url, req=spec, headers=self._headers(), retry=self.retry
        )

        body = handle_response(response)

        def fetch(params: dict[str, Any] | None, url: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:

                url if url else spec.path,
                params=params or spec.params,
                absolute=bool(url),

            return self._execute(target)

def _pick_class(code: int | None, status: int) -> type[ApiError]:
    if status == 401 or code == 190:
        return AuthError
    if status == 403 or code in (10, 200):
        return PermissionError_
    if status == 404 or (code == 100 and status == 404):
        return NotFoundError
    if code in _RATE_LIMIT_CODES:
        return RateLimitError
    if code is not None:
        if 131000 <= code < 132000:
            if code in (131051, 131052):
                return MediaError
            return MessagingError
        if 132000 <= code < 133000:
            return ValidationError
        if 133000 <= code < 134000:
            return RegistrationError
        if 138000 <= code < 139000:
            return CallError
    if status == 429:
        return RateLimitError
    if status >= 500:
        return ApiError
    return ApiError

@dataclass
class RetryPolicy:
    """Exponential backoff with jitter for retryable failures."""

    max_retries: int = 3
    base_delay: float = 0.5
    max_delay: float = 30.0

    def delay_for(self, attempt: int, retry_after: float | None) -> float:
        if retry_after is not None:
            return min(float(retry_after), self.max_delay)
        backoff = min(self.base_delay * (2**attempt), self.max_delay)
        return float(backoff * (0.5 + random.random() * 0.5))

class Files:
    """Helper to build httpx multipart ``files`` payloads from user input.

    Accepts a path (str/Path), raw bytes, or an open binary file object.
    """

    @staticmethod
    def open(file: Any, filename: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, Any, str | None]:
        from pathlib import Path

        if isinstance(file, (str, Path)):
            path = Path(file)
            return (path.name, path.read_bytes(), _guess_mime(path.name))
        if isinstance(file, bytes):
            return (filename or "file", file, _guess_mime(filename or ""))
        # file-like object
        name = filename or getattr(file, "name", "file") or "file"
        name = str(name).rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        return (name, file, _guess_mime(name))

def handle_response(response: httpx.Response) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Decode a Graph API response or raise the mapped :class:`ApiError`."""
    if response.is_success:
        if not response.content:
            return {}
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            body = {"raw": response.text}
        return body if isinstance(body, dict) else {"data": body}
    payload: dict[str, Any]

    except json.JSONDecodeError:

def request_with_retry(
    http: httpx.Client,
    *,
    url: str,
    req: ApiRequest[T],
    headers: dict[str, str],
    retry: RetryPolicy,
) -> httpx.Response:
    """Execute one request, retrying retryable failures with backoff."""
    last_exc: ApiError | None = None
    for attempt in range(retry.max_retries + 1):
        response = http.request(
            req.method,
            url,
            params=req.params,
            json=req.json,
            data=req.data,
            files=req.files,
            headers=headers | (req.headers or {}),
        )
        if response.is_success:
            return response
        try:
            raise error_from_response(
                response.status_code,
                _safe_json(response),
                _retry_after(response.headers),
            )
        except ApiError as exc:
            last_exc = exc
            if attempt >= retry.max_retries or not is_retryable(exc):
                raise
            sleep(retry.delay_for(attempt, exc.retry_after))
    assert last_exc is not None  # unreachable
    raise last_exc

    """Recursively drop ``None`` values from a JSON body."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in body.items():

class CursorIterator(Generic[T], Iterator[T]):
    """Lazy iterator over a cursor-paginated endpoint."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        fetch: Fetcher,
        *,
        params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        decode: ItemDecoder[T] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._fetch = fetch
        self._params = dict(params or {})
        self._decode: ItemDecoder[T] = decode or _passthrough
        self._buffer: list[T] = []
        self._next_url: str | None = None
        self._first = True
        self._exhausted = False
        self._seen_urls: set[str] = set()

    def __iter__(self) -> CursorIterator[T]:
        return self

    def __next__(self) -> T:
        while not self._buffer:
            if self._exhausted:
                raise StopIteration
            self._load_page()
        return self._buffer.pop(0)

    def _load_page(self) -> None:
        if self._first:
            payload = self._fetch(self._params, None)
            self._first = False
        else:
            assert self._next_url is not None
            payload = self._fetch(None, self._next_url)
        _, _, nxt = _cursors(payload)
        self._buffer.extend(self._decode(item) for item in payload.get("data") or [])
        # Guard against a server/mock returning the same cursor twice.
        if nxt and nxt not in self._seen_urls:
            self._next_url = nxt
            self._seen_urls.add(nxt)
        else:
            self._exhausted = True

    def pages(self) -> Iterator[Page[T]]:
        """Iterate page-by-page instead of item-by-item."""
        params: dict[str, Any] | None = self._params
        url: str | None = None
        first = True
        while True:
            payload = self._fetch(params if first else None, url)
            first = False
            before, after, nxt = _cursors(payload)
            items = [self._decode(i) for i in payload.get("data") or []]
            yield Page(data=items, before=before, after=after, has_next=bool(nxt))
            if not nxt:
                return
            url = nxt

    def send(
        self,

        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,

        self,
        message_id: str,

class Media(Resource):
    """``/{phone-number-id}/media`` + ``/{media-id}`` operations."""

    def upload(
        self,
        file: Any,
        *,
        mime_type: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> MediaUploadResult:
        """Upload media for use in messages.

        ``file`` accepts a path, ``bytes``, or an open binary file.
        Returns an object with a media ``id`` (valid ~30 days).
        """
        return self._req(_upload_spec(self._pnid(phone_number_id), file, mime_type))

    def get(self, media_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> MediaInfo:
        """Retrieve a media object — includes a temporary download ``url``."""
        return self._req(_info_spec(media_id, phone_number_id))

    def delete(self, media_id: str, *, phone_number_id: str | None = None) -> bool:
        body = self._req(_delete_spec(media_id, phone_number_id))
        return bool(body.get("success"))

    def download(
        self,
        media: str | MediaInfo,
        dest: str | Path | None = None,
        *,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> bytes | Path:
        """Download media bytes.

        ``media`` may be a media ID, a ``MediaInfo``, or a raw download URL.
        When ``dest`` is given the file is written and its path returned.
        """
        url: str | None
        if isinstance(media, MediaInfo):
            url = media.url
        elif media.startswith("http"):
            url = media
        else:
            url = self.get(media, phone_number_id=phone_number_id).url
        if not url:
            raise ValueError("no download URL available for this media")
        data = self._c._download(url)
        if dest is not None:
            path = Path(dest)
            path.write_bytes(data)
            return path
        return data

    def resumable_upload(
        self,
        file: Any,
        *,
        mime_type: str | None = None,
        app_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Resumable Upload API → an asset *handle* (``h:…``).

        Required for template header media and profile pictures.
        ``app_id`` defaults to the client's ``app_id``.
        """
        return self._c._resumable_upload(file, mime_type=mime_type, app_id=app_id)

        self,
        to: str,
        sdp: str,

        biz_opaque_callback_data: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> CallResult:
        """Initiate a call — ``sdp`` is the local SDP *offer* (RFC 8866)."""
        body = _call_body(
            "connect",
            to=to,
            sdp_type="offer",
            sdp=sdp,

class Groups(Resource):
    """Create and manage WhatsApp groups for the business number."""

    def list(
        self,
        *,
        limit: int | None = None,
        after: str | None = None,
        before: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> Any:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/groups",
            params=clean_params({"limit": limit, "after": after, "before": before}),
        )
        return self._page(spec, Group.model_validate)

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        subject: str,
        description: str | None = None,
        join_approval_mode: str | None = None,
        phone_number_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> GroupCreated:
        body = _group_body(
            subject=subject, description=description, join_approval_mode=join_approval_mode
        )
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "POST",
            f"{self._pnid(phone_number_id)}/groups",
            json=body,
            into=GroupCreated.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def get(self, group_id: str, *, fields: Sequence[str] | str | None = None) -> Group:
        spec = ApiRequest(
            "GET",
            group_id,
            params=clean_params({"fields": merge_fields(fields)}),
            into=Group.model_validate,
        )
        return self._req(spec)

    def update(
        self,
        group_id: str,
        *,
        subject: str | None = None,
        description: str | None = None,
        profile_picture: str | Path | bytes | None = None,
        profile_picture_file: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Update subject/description; set picture via ``profile_picture``
        (path/bytes → multipart) or a server-side ``profile_picture_file`` path."""
        if profile_picture is not None:
            import mimetypes

            name = getattr(profile_picture, "name", None) or "picture.jpg"
            if isinstance(profile_picture, (str, Path)):
                p = Path(profile_picture)
                content = p.read_bytes()
                name = p.name
            else:
                content = profile_picture
            spec = ApiRequest(
                "POST",
                group_id,
                data={"messaging_product": "whatsapp"},
                files={"file": (name, content, mimetypes.guess_type(str(name))[0] or "image/jpeg")},
            )
            return self._req(spec)
        body = _group_body(
            subject=subject, description=description, profile_picture_file=profile_picture_file
        )
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", group_id, json=body))

    def delete(self, group_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", group_id))

    # --- participants -------------------------------------------------------

    def add_participants(self, group_id: str, participants: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Add up to 8 members per call (phone numbers or WA-IDs)."""
        body = _group_body(participants=participants)
        return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", f"{group_id}/participants", json=body))

    def remove_participants(self, group_id: str, participants: Sequence[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = _group_body(participants=participants)
        return self._req(ApiRequest("DELETE", f"{group_id}/participants", json=body))

    # --- invite links --------------------------------------------------------

    def create_invite_link(self, group_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:

        subject=subject, description=description, profile_picture_file=profile_picture_file
    )
    return self._req(ApiRequest("POST", group_id, json=body))

    """Async resource bound to an :class:`wapi.AsyncClient`."""

    def __init__(self, client: AsyncClient) -> None:
        self._c = client

    async def _req(self, spec: ApiRequest[T]) -> T:
        return await self._c._execute(spec)

    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

    ) -> dict[str, Any]:

def clean_body(body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recursively drop ``None`` values from a JSON body."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in body.items():
        if value is None:
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            out[key] = clean_body(value)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            out[key] = [clean_body(v) if isinstance(v, dict) else v for v in value]
        else:
            out[key] = value
    return out

def parse(payload: dict[str, Any] | str | bytes) -> list[ev.WebhookEvent]:
    """Parse a webhook body into one typed event per change.

    A ``messages`` change produces an :class:`InboundMessages` event when it
    contains ``messages`` and a :class:`StatusUpdates` event when it contains
    ``statuses`` (they may both come from the same change).
    """
    if isinstance(payload, (str, bytes)):
        payload = json.loads(payload)
    body = WebhookPayload.model_validate(payload)
    out: list[ev.WebhookEvent] = []
    for entry in body.entry:
        for change in entry.changes:
            out.extend(parse_change(entry.id, change.field, change.value))
    return out

def _parse_messages(waba_id: str, field: str, value: dict[str, Any]) -> list[ev.WebhookEvent]:
    out: list[ev.WebhookEvent] = []
    metadata = None
    if isinstance(value.get("metadata"), dict):
        metadata = WebhookMetadata.model_validate(value["metadata"])

    if value.get("messages"):
        messages = [InboundMessage.model_validate(m) for m in value["messages"]]
        contacts = [WebhookContact.model_validate(c) for c in value.get("contacts") or []]
        out.append(
            ev.InboundMessages(
                field=field,
                waba_id=waba_id,
                value=value,
                messages=messages,
                contacts=contacts,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )
    if value.get("statuses"):
        statuses = [MessageStatus.model_validate(s) for s in value["statuses"]]
        out.append(
            ev.StatusUpdates(
                field=field,
                waba_id=waba_id,
                value=value,
                statuses=statuses,
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )
    if value.get("message_echoes"):
        out.append(
            ev.SmbMessageEcho(
                field=field,
                waba_id=waba_id,
                value=value,
                message_echoes=list(value["message_echoes"]),
            )
        )
    if value.get("calls"):
        out.append(
            ev.CallEvent(
                field=field,
                waba_id=waba_id,
                value=value,
                calls=list(value["calls"]),
                metadata=metadata,
            )
        )
    if not out:
        out.append(ev.UnknownEvent(field=field, waba_id=waba_id, value=value))
    return out

def webhook_router(
    handler: Handler | BatchHandler,
    *,
    verify_token: str,
    app_secret: str | None = None,
    path: str = "/webhook",
    per_event: bool = True,
) -> Any:
    """Build a FastAPI ``APIRouter`` handling webhook verification + dispatch.

    - ``GET {path}`` answers Meta's verification challenge.
    - ``POST {path}`` verifies ``X-Hub-Signature-256`` (when ``app_secret``
      is set), parses events, and calls ``handler``.

    With ``per_event=True`` (default) ``handler`` is invoked once per event;
    with ``False`` it receives the whole ``list[WebhookEvent]``.
    Sync and async handlers are both supported.
    """
    if not _HAS_FASTAPI:  # pragma: no cover
        raise ImportError("webhook_router requires the 'fastapi' extra: pip install wapi[fastapi]")

    router = APIRouter()

    async def _dispatch(events: list[WebhookEvent]) -> None:
        if per_event:
            for event in events:
                result = handler(event)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                    await result
        else:
            result = handler(events)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            if inspect.isawaitable(result):
                await result

    @router.get(path)
    async def verify(request: Request) -> Response:
        challenge = verify_webhook_challenge(
            request.query_params.get("hub.mode"),
            request.query_params.get("hub.verify_token"),
            request.query_params.get("hub.challenge"),
            verify_token,
        )
        if challenge is not None:
            return PlainTextResponse(challenge)
        return PlainTextResponse("Forbidden", status_code=403)

    @router.post(path)
    async def receive(request: Request) -> Response:
        raw = await request.body()
        if app_secret is not None:
            sig = request.headers.get("x-hub-signature-256")
            if not verify_signature(raw, sig, app_secret):
                return PlainTextResponse("Invalid signature", status_code=401)
        try:
            events = parse(json.loads(raw))
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as e:
            raise WebhookSignatureError("malformed webhook payload") from e
        await _dispatch(events)
        return PlainTextResponse("OK")

    return router

docs.title: Errors & Retries
docs.text:
Every non-2xx response raises an ApiError subclass:

from wapi import ApiError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, TemplateError

try:
    client.messages.send_text(to, "hi")
except RateLimitError as e:
    time.sleep(e.retry_after or 1)
except TemplateError as e:
    print(e.code, e.subcode, e.details)
except ApiError as e:
    print(e.status_code, e.error_type, e.fbtrace_id)
Class When AuthError 401 / code 190 — bad or expired token PermissionError_ 403 — missing scope/capability NotFoundError 404 RateLimitError codes 4/17/32/341/368/613/80007/130429/131048/131056 — has .retry_after ValidationError 132xxx — bad params MessagingError 131xxx — send/delivery failures TemplateError template ops MediaError media ops RegistrationError 133xxx — number registration CallError 138xxx — calling API WebhookSignatureError invalid webhook signature

Automatic retries (default 3, exponential backoff + jitter) apply to rate limits, 5xx, and transient codes 1/2/120.

from fastapi import FastAPI

app = FastAPI()
